## 0.2.275

owes: none — build and agent tooling: `tooling/` re-pinned v0.1.22 → v0.1.26 and the `preflight@` ref in `release.yml` follows (Tooling's interval is `owes: none` for this repository: the `release`/`finish` secrets move is already done here, `finish` takes `gh-token` as an input); DataCore's `feed`, `weather`, `stocks`, `notes` and `tennis` cores re-pinned 0.5.39 → 0.5.40, whose interval owes nothing (docs, `toString` and test changes in the storage cores this hub does not use).
owes: none — the release workflow tags and cuts the Release through Tooling's `finish` action, after the images and the feed (SPEC-187 §10): the feed names a notes page, not the Release, so writing it first announces nothing that cannot be installed; a failed `finish` is re-run. CI only, nothing an operator runs changes.
owes: none — `GuardedResolverProvider`, `ResolverExemptions` and `EgressRefusedException` move from the `rss` package to `egress` (SPEC-187, REV-HUB-28), with the JDK services file that names the provider; no behaviour change.
owes: none — a *Test connection* or a sensor check cancelled mid-window now still closes its broker link, so its Netty event loop no longer outlives it (SPEC-151, REV-HUB-21).
owes: none — Settings → Devices → *Pair a device* lays out the QR beside the values, each value under its label in a box one click selects, and the link in a closed *Show the link* fold after them; the other one-time values (the second factor's secret, a file token, the recovery codes) take the same label-over-value drawing (SPEC-196). `uiModel` is unchanged; the engine zip's `ui-strings/` gains `show.pairing.showLink`.
owes: none — App backups uses the page's data width: the kept apps' cards and *Not backed up yet* sit in two columns from the wide breakpoint, and a backup's row wraps its buttons at its card's width rather than the window's (SPEC-197). `uiModel` is unchanged; no string changes.
owes: SyncDesk — `uiModel` 22 (SPEC-198): the `tennis.newsItem` destination (`/tennis/news/{id}`, `reading` width) and its `tennis.news.read` action with the engine relay of the same name (`POST /api/v1/tennis/news/{id}/read`), a `NewsRow`'s `imageKey` now also served under `GET /tennis/image/{key}` (`media.image` asks the feed then the stocks route only, so a tennis square draws empty there until a later spec adds a third), and `TennisCalendarFacts.state` (`ok`, `pending`, `failed`); the engine zip's `ui-strings/` gains `tennis.calendar.pending|failed|failedLink` and `tennis.news.markRead|markUnread` and drops `tennis.news.opening`. SyncDesk raises its floor to 22. No migration, no configuration key, no wire collection.
owes: a changed behaviour (SPEC-198 §4) — `POST /tennis/news/open` and its *Opening…* page are removed and answer `404`; a tennis headline opens a page of its own and is marked read once that page has rendered. The tennis season request alone may read a body of up to 64 MiB (the day cards, rankings, search and news keep 5 MiB): the calendar, empty since the source's season grew past 5 MiB, fills at the next daily fetch; the hub holds up to 64 MiB transiently once a day. The hub also dials the tennis feed's thumbnail addresses, at most 20 a round, through the egress guard. No migration, no configuration key.
owes: none — citations of other repositories' specs follow their three-digit numbering (AppShell `SPEC-033`, WeatherScraper `SPEC-049-scraping.md`) in comments and KDoc; no behaviour, API, wire or build change.
owes: SyncDesk — `uiModel` 19 (SPEC-192 §4): a `Group` gains `toggle` (default `false`), and `readerViewCommands` marks the `showRead` group a toggle group of two options, the first on; a renderer that does not know the field still draws the two options, but SyncDesk refuses an engine above its floor, so it raises its floor to 19 and draws a toggle group as one switch (SyncDesk SPEC-033). No migration, no configuration key, no wire change, no `ui-strings/` change; the web pages draw Settings → Apps, Settings → Interface → *Slide* and the `⋮` panel's *Show read* as a switch instead of buttons.
